symptom: sync-java-deps reported 'still missing from vendorlib/: [org.bouncycastle:bcprov-jdk18on:1.81]' while bcprov-jdk18on-1.81.1.jar was there and mx check was clean.
cause: jarVendored matched a plain declared version to exactly <artifact>-<version>.jar; Gradle keeps the newest version any dependency in the graph asks for, so a transitive dependency's newer patch is what gets vendored.
fix: A newer release with the same major.minor (1.81 -> 1.81.1, 3.18.0 -> 3.18.1) satisfies a plain version; another minor or a qualifier does not, keeping WrongVersionVendored. The 'still missing' errors now name the versions vendorlib holds (DescribeUnvendored).
insight: mxcli sees only the declared coordinates, Gradle sees the whole graph; a postcondition check on its output must allow what Gradle may legitimately choose. #1450 (two declarations) and #2028 (ranges) were the same class.
test: cmd/mxcli/docker/javadeps_patch_version_2248_test.go (controls: older patch, another minor and a -beta qualifier stay missing)
